setup: Lie on a flat bench, feet planted
Dumbbells over your chest, palms in
Arms straight, upper arms near vertical
execution: Lower the weights beside your head
faults: Don't let your elbows flare out
Don't drop the weights toward your face

notes: Lower the dumbbells to the sides of the head, not onto the forehead, and control every rep.
Start light; elbows are often the limit before the triceps.
Finish by bringing the dumbbells to your chest before sitting up.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Lying on a flat bench, feet flat. Arms straight up over the chest, dumbbells held with palms facing each other.

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Elbows bent about 90° or a little more, upper arms still near vertical (tilted slightly back), dumbbells beside the head at ear level.

ikHints: Back and head stay on the bench
guideBrief.barPath: Dumbbells arc from over the chest down to beside the head
